name: baseline-no-context
hypothesis: No context is sent, so the agent behaves as in the frozen 30-run table (26 REVERSE_AND_REPLAN / 4 RETRY_NAVIGATION / 0 HALT). This is the control.

name: open-corridor-slow
hypothesis: RETRY_NAVIGATION is chosen more often than in the control: lots of free space ahead and the robot is crawling.

name: obstacle-close-moving
hypothesis: More cautious than the control: HALT or REVERSE_AND_REPLAN, RETRY_NAVIGATION almost never.

name: persistent-fault
hypothesis: RETRY_NAVIGATION is rarer than in the control: a 30 s fault is not a brief glitch and the obstacle reading is 25 s old.

name: complete-near-goal
hypothesis: Still HALT in nearly every run: with no sensing at all, being close to the goal should not change that.
